text: A number of Exhibition Place employees should be recognized by the Board for recent outstanding accomplishments: 1. Corporate Responsibility Employee of the Year - 2017 Mr. Radek Bedorf is recognized as the 2017 Corporate Social Responsibility Employee of the Year. Mr. Bedorf in achieving Platinum Level status has demonstrated his personal commitment to social responsibility and environmental sustainability at Exhibition Place. The Corporate Social Responsibility Program commenced in 2014 and provides to each staff member their own report card on their individual everyday use and practices, so that each employee can see and set their personal goals for improvements. The areas focused on are: mode of transportation to work; energy savings in the office; paper consumption; participation in our recognition program; and volunteer participation in various staff committees and community…

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place applauded and extended congratulations to the following Exhibition Place staff: 1. Radek Bedorf as the 2017 Corporate Social Responsibility Employee of the Year. 2. Frank Tantalo on being recognized as the 2017 Employee of the Year. 3. Ms. Debbie Sanderson for her outstanding efforts on the United Way City of Toronto Campaign. 4. Ms. Christine Baghdadlian and Ms. Songul Karakaya on being recognized by the Toronto Fire Services for the Rescue and Merit Award.
